Master Application Key is incompatible with the S3 API; generate a dedicated Application Key (keyID maps to AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, applicationKey maps to AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY) scoped to a single bucket and optional fileNamePrefix with Read/Write permissions. To delete a B2 bucket, first delete all files and versions in the bucket, then in the Backblaze web console open B2 Cloud Storage, Buckets, Bucket Settings, and select Delete Bucket.
Deleting a standard Application Key in Application Keys or via b2_delete_key immediately removes access for that key without disrupting other keys.
